style: A Prime Video-style title trailer for a portfolio, in the site's own brand: a personal 'bhavini original' ident, then the title's generated key art with a slow push-in, the title lettering rising in at the left like Prime's hero, a mint status line, two count-up stats, and an end card with Prime's white 'Watch now' button and a blue-check 'Open to roles' line. No Amazon or Prime Video marks, no audio.

palette_roles.art: per-title key art from scripts/art (f1jobs blues, vastra-kala ambers, christ-university indigo and gold)

font: Inter Variable from assets/fonts (the site's UI face)

beat_names.2.1: key art in, slow push-in starts (runs to 12.0)
beat_names.2.9: title lettering rises in; eyebrow above
beat_names.5.1: stat 1 counts up, label and detail follow
beat_names.10.4: end card: lettering, Watch now, Open to roles; holds to 12.0
beat_names.8.05: stat 2 counts up (after stat 1 has cleared)

export_spec.container: mp4 (H.264, yuv420p, faststart, no audio) + webm (VP9, no audio), 1920x1080, 30 fps, 12.0 s
export_spec.post: scripts/trailers/finalize.ts encodes, checks size, writes poster and WebVTT captions into public/trailers/

asset_needs_note: No search: key art, lettering and ident come from the site's own generators (scripts/art, scripts/brand) via scripts/trailers/assets.ts.
